KarteaPhaseService

class KarteaPhaseService(dao=None)[source]

Bases: object

Service (MVCS) of the KarTEA phases and levels.

Business rules of the phases, read from the CSV files (resources/phases): which phases and levels exist, the progression between them (advance, regress) and the rules of each level (interval, amount and type of objects, speed range).

Parameters:
daoKarteaPhaseCsvDAO | None, optional

DAO of the phases. Created if None. Kept private.

Notes

The CSV files are read once, on first use, and kept in cache (phases in order, the sorted level ids of each phase, and each KarteaPhaseLevel indexed by the (phase, level) pair).

Examples

>>> from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
>>> phases = [
...     NS(id=1, level_list=[NS(id=1), NS(id=2)]),
...     NS(id=2, level_list=[NS(id=1)]),
... ]
>>> service = KarteaPhaseService(dao=NS(list=lambda: phases))
>>> service.next_level(1, 1)
(1, 2)
>>> service.next_level(1, 2)
(2, 1)
>>> service.previous_level(2, 1)
(2, 1)

next_level(phase_id, level_id)[source]

Return the next phase/level.

Parameters:
phase_idint

Current phase.

level_idint

Current level.

Returns:
tuple[int, int]

The (phase, level) to play next.

Notes

Advances one level within the phase; after the last level of the phase, moves to the first level of the next phase. On the last level of the last phase, stays. Uses the actual number of phases and levels in the CSV files.

previous_level(phase_id, level_id)[source]

Parameters:
phase_idint

Current phase.

level_idint

Current level.

Returns:
tuple[int, int]

The (phase, level) to play next.

Notes

On the first level of the phase, stays (does not go back a phase).

static speed_for_level(level_id)[source]

Return the speed range (1, 2 or 3) of a level.

Parameters:
level_idint

Id of the level.

Returns:
int

1 for levels 1-2, 2 for levels 3-4 and 3 (DEFAULT_SPEED) for the others. The phase CSV files have no speed column.

Examples

>>> KarteaPhaseService.speed_for_level(3)
2
>>> KarteaPhaseService.speed_for_level(7)
3
get_level_rules(phase_id, level_id)[source]

Return the rules of a level, read from the phase CSV file.

Parameters:
phase_idint

Id of the phase.

level_idint

Id of the level.

Returns:
LevelRules

interval (s between objects), num_obj (maximum number of objects) and obj_types (0 target, 1 obstacle, in order) from the CSV, plus the speed range of the level.

Notes

If the phase/level does not exist, default rules are returned: interval DEFAULT_LEVEL_INTERVAL, no object limit and random types.
